description: The dataset explicitly contains experimental conditions, analytical results, setup details and procedures for sodium/potassium cation-exchange membrane experiments in greenhouse wastewater reuse. Native files comprise DOCX and PDF documents. The registered article abstract describes two crown-ether-modified membranes, tests with equimolar and greenhouse-wastewater feed ratios, low overall selectivity and a marginal improvement in potassium selectivity for one modification. This distinct membrane-material comparison is not treated as the same experiment as the capacitive-electrodialysis pilot. Individual sample counts, numeric concentrations and geographic experiment location remain unknown. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
